notes: Stratified seed for the M0 corpus. CN-first because several global sites are unreliable from this network. URLs were reachability-probed once (HTTP GET) on 2026-09-18; anything that failed the probe is recorded in droppedCandidates instead of being seeded. Unreachable pages during a run are recorded in corpus/failures.json, never dropped silently. Robots-denied pages are kept with `skip: true` plus a droppedCandidates entry, so nothing is silently removed. Tier model (2026-09-28): every site is tagged `tier: "exemplar"` (industry-recognized top-tier design for a professional/commercial/industrial scenario — the population coverage claims are made against, per design-basis §8) or `tier: "support"` (structural coverage: tables/forms/docs/enterprise/utility; real pages, but no coverage claim), each with a one-line `justification`. Seven new exemplar sites (linear-app, stripe-com, stripe-docs, airbnb-com, gov-uk, apple-com-cn, grafana-play) were reachability- and robots-probed on 2026-09-28 before seeding. Round 9 (2026-09-29): four further exemplar sites (aliyun-help, aws-amazon, stripe-dashboard, xiaomi-account) plus one gov-uk page were added to close the exemplar-layer evidence gap for the M4 `table` and `login` primitives (before this round: 0 exemplar pages with a <table> or a type=password field). Robots-probed and recorded in .scratch/08-exemplar-expansion/report.md.
